message.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>This research concerns the development of a parametric format for the semantic description of 3D city models. Following a brief review of the state of the art, the case study is introduced (an historical city block in Catania) whose geometries will be semantically organised through the VPL Grasshopper.</jats:p>
title: A Proposal for a Parametric 3D City Model Semantic Format
